interpolation_mechanics.alpha_large_title: alpha_large = clamp((52.0 - dy) / 12.0, 0.0, 1.0) for dy in [40.0, 52.0]

content_scroll_vs_sheet_arbitration.rule_large_detent_downward_pan: If inner scroll view contentOffset.y > -contentInset.top, inner scroll view consumes 100% of downward drag. Once contentOffset.y reaches -contentInset.top, sheet pan interaction engages, translating sheet downwards.
content_scroll_vs_sheet_arbitration.rule_large_detent_upward_pan: Inner scroll view consumes upward drag. Sheet remains pinned at large detent frame.
content_scroll_vs_sheet_arbitration.rule_medium_detent_upward_pan: If prefersScrollingExpandsWhenScrolledToEdge == YES, sheet expands from medium to large detent before inner scroll view scrolls content. Inner scroll offset is locked at -contentInset.top during expansion.
content_scroll_vs_sheet_arbitration.rule_excess_expansion_handoff: When sheet reaches large detent during upward pan expansion, any excess drag displacement immediately transitions into inner scroll view content scrolling.
content_scroll_vs_sheet_arbitration.dismissal_decision_gate: On touch lift (touchesEnded:), if downward velocity > 600.0 pt/s OR sheet displacement below lowest detent > 60.0 pt, sheet initiates animated dismissal; otherwise it springs back to nearest detent.

custom_detent_resolution_mechanics.multi_detent_nearest_anchor_algorithm: Target detent is resolved via nearest distance argmin_i |y_sheet - detent_i| across all configured detents (including custom detents).
custom_detent_resolution_mechanics.min_detent_anchor_determination: The displacement gate evaluates relative to min(D) across all active detents, guaranteeing robust behavior even when detent arrays are unsorted.
custom_detent_resolution_mechanics.dismissal_precedence: If downward velocity > 600.0 pt/s or displacement falls below lowest detent by > 60.0 pt, sheet dismisses (target detent = 0.0) regardless of proximity to nearest detent.

sheet_vs_refresh_control_conflict.refreshing_downward_drag_rule: When inner scroll view is in active RefreshRefreshing state (+60pt pinned top inset), pulling down at the pinned detent directly translates the sheet downward, and high downward velocity (> 600 pt/s) dismisses the sheet.

state_machine_states.name: Idle
state_machine_states.description: contentOffset.y >= -contentInset.top. Refresh control completely hidden, spinner stationary, alpha = 0.0.

state_machine_states.name: Pulling
state_machine_states.description: User pulls downward into overscroll (-60.0pt < dy < 0.0pt). Progress p = |dy| / 60.0pt scales linearly in [0.0, 1.0]. Spinner indicator rotates/expands proportionately.

state_machine_states.name: Triggered
state_machine_states.description: |dy| >= 60.0pt while finger is still held down. Trigger condition satisfied. Light impact haptic pulse dispatched.

state_machine_states.name: Refreshing
state_machine_states.description: User lifts finger while in Triggered state. beginRefreshing fired. contentInset.top temporarily pinned by +60.0pt via spring animation. Spinner spins continuously.

state_machine_states.name: Finishing
state_machine_states.description: App invokes endRefreshing. Inset restores to original top margin over 0.25s. Spinner fades out over 0.15s, returning to Idle state.

tracking_geometry.engagement_condition: Touch point in window coordinate space touches keyboard top frame: P_touch.y >= Y_keyboard_top
tracking_geometry.pan_translation_formula: Y_kb_current = max(Y_keyboard_top, P_touch.y); Delta_Y_kb = Y_kb_current - Y_keyboard_top

cutoff_arbitration.upward_flick_cancellation_rule: If release velocity is upward and exceeds -400.0 pt/s (vy < -400.0 pt/s), dismiss gate is cancelled and keyboard snaps back to fully visible frame even if travel displacement exceeded 50% of keyboard height.
cutoff_arbitration.first_responder_resignation_action: [firstResponder resignFirstResponder] invoked upon satisfying dismiss gate

asynchronous_interruption.external_resignation_behavior: If [firstResponder resignFirstResponder] or an external UI event occurs mid-pan, interactive tracking immediately cancels (is_tracking = false) and keyboard animates to dismissed frame (is_dismissed = true, current_keyboard_y = window_height).
